organization.name: Fastmail
organization.notes: Independent employee-owned company, service operating since 1999. Staff repurchased business from Opera in 2013; Opera is historical owner, not current parent. Official values and ownership pages do not establish complete financing history; bootstrapped status or no historical investors not inferred.

pricingTiers.name: Business Basic
pricingTiers.notes: Published $4/user/month monthly or $36 for 12 months. Custom domains require at least one Standard or Professional user on account; Basic lacks third-party mail-client access.

pricingTiers.name: Business Standard
pricingTiers.notes: Explicit Most popular badge. Published $6/user/month monthly or $60 for 12 months.

pricingTiers.name: Business Standard
pricingTiers.notes: Named business plan; 50 GB mail/calendar/contacts plus 10 GB files per user. Published annual total $60.
No separate named Enterprise tier or quoted enterprise offer identified. Professional is $10 monthly/$108 yearly but not labelled Enterprise; not silently substituted.

moats.claim: Email, calendar and shared-address workflow habits create switching friction, although standard protocols limit proprietary lock-in.

productReasons.claim: Masked Email aliases help separate online account identities from the main inbox.
Shared calendars, contacts and email addresses coordinate small business correspondence.
Scheduled Send, Snooze and inbox rules help users manage follow-up timing and incoming mail.
